links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of LLMs in interactive versus static case presentation
links.effect: Every model loses diagnostic accuracy in the interactive setting relative to the static setting; performance varies considerably across models.
links.quote: Performance varies considerably across models in the interactive setting, and every model loses diagnostic accuracy relative to the static setting, where the full case is presented upfront.

unlisted_practices: Evaluating LLM hypothesis-driven information gathering (history taking and test ordering) in interactive simulated encounters rather than static vignettes

screen.reason: Introduces and evaluates an interactive benchmark (Hx2Dx ARENA) testing conversational clinical reasoning and hypothesis-driven inquiry in LLMs compared to static benchmarks.
